name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_sex_is_female_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is female.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as female.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not female (e.g., male, other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_sex_is_male_now

name: patient_asa_physical_status_classification_value_now
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current ASA physical status classification.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current ASA physical status classification is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the integer value corresponding to the patient's current ASA physical status classification (e.g., 1, 2, 3, etc.) as assessed at the present time.

name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kg_per_m2
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kilograms per square meter (kg/m^2).
when_unknown: Set to null if no such BMI measurement recorded now is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured BMI value if a numeric measurement of the patient's body mass index (kg/m^2) recorded now is available.
